summary: Görev Kopyalama (Kopyala → Yapıştır) — backend fully tested (11/11 passing). Web/mobile paste-flow UI E2E was NOT completed by this agent because the login form uses testIDs that differ from [data-testid=login-username-input]/[data-testid=login-password-input] (Playwright timed out waiting for those selectors on the SERTEX login terminal). Main agent had already smoke-verified web copy→clipboard-bar via screenshot per the agent-to-agent note; the backend-level assertions cover 100% of the paste result so any UI-only issue would be limited to menu wiring.
action_items: Recommended: main agent runs manual/self-test for the web (Detaylı + Kolay) paste UI and the mobile task/[id] Kopyala flow — backend is proven, only UI wiring needs a visual pass. If retest is needed, testing agent must first discover the login-form testIDs (login form testIDs are NOT `login-username-input`/`login-password-input` in this build).
Cleanup: '(Kopya) TEST_dup_*' rows already permanently purged by the pytest teardown (DELETE /api/tasks/{id} → DELETE /api/tasks/{id}/permanent for every task the tests created).
critical_code_review_comments: duplicate_task uses `top` scoped to `user_id: owner_id, sort_order != None` but sort_order is stored as float; the increment (top.sort_order + 1) is fine but there is no upper bound — after many pastes this drifts. Not a bug, just observation.

duplicate_task copies `company_name` verbatim from src but sets `company_id` from the *caller's* users doc — if src is from a different company the label (company_name text) and id can go out of sync. Consider deriving both from the caller.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_dup_* source tasks + '(Kopya) ...' duplicates transiently; teardown fixture permanently deletes every id at module exit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend duplicate endpoint fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_task_duplicate.py (single-worker: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_task_duplicate.py -o addopts=''`). Attachment download endpoint is `/api/tasks/{tid}/attachments/{att_id}/download` (NOT `/api/tasks/{tid}/attachments/{att_id}`). Before running Playwright web UI, first inspect the SERTEX login form — its inputs use testIDs different from `login-username-input`/`login-password-input`; grep `frontend/src` for `login-` testIDs or use text-based selectors ("Kullanıcı adı" / "Şifre" / "Giriş Yap").
